submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (85.315%) among all deployable options. While Algorithm-L3 showed higher raw efficiency (90-92%), it was excluded due to its 5.8 μs latency violating the 4 μs hardware budget constraint. Algorithm-L2 had significantly lower efficiency (peak 74.873%). Algorithm-L1 meets all hardware constraints with 3.1 μs latency, falls within the 20-60 GeV threshold range, and delivers optimal performance at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.
